statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(basename "$(pwd)"); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf "%s (%s) | %s" "$dir" "$branch" "$model"; else printf "%s | %s" "$dir" "$model"; fi

hooks.command: data=$(cat); prompt=$(echo "$data" | jq -r '.prompt // ""'); sessionId=$(echo "$data" | jq -r '.sessionId // "unknown"'); curl -s -X POST http://localhost:5501/hooks/user-prompt-submit -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"prompt\": \"$prompt\", \"sessionId\": \"$sessionId\", \"timestamp\": $(date +%s)}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

data=$(cat); tool=$(echo "$data" | jq -r '.toolName // "unknown"'); params=$(echo "$data" | jq -c '.parameters // {}'); curl -s -X POST http://localhost:5501/hooks/tool-call -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"tool\": \"$tool\", \"parameters\": $params, \"stage\": \"pre\", \"timestamp\": $(date +%s)}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

data=$(cat); json=$(echo "$data" | jq -c '{workflowId: (now | tostring), model: (.model // "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929"), inputTokens: (.usage.inputTokens // 0), outputTokens: (.usage.outputTokens // 0), timestamp: now}'); curl -s -X POST http://localhost:5501/hooks/token-usage -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$json" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

sessionId=$(uuidgen); curl -s -X POST http://localhost:5501/hooks/session-start -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"sessionId\": \"$sessionId\", \"timestamp\": $(date +%s), \"workingDir\": \"$(pwd)\"}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "ORCHESTRAI_SESSION_ID=$sessionId" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"

data=$(cat); notificationType=$(echo "$data" | jq -r '.type // "unknown"'); message=$(echo "$data" | jq -r '.message // ""'); curl -s -X POST http://localhost:5501/hooks/notification -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"type\": \"$notificationType\", \"message\": \"$message\", \"timestamp\": $(date +%s)}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
